name: webview_extension_docs
description: Read the bundled extension SDK. Start here: default README.md includes the authoring workflow. list_only lists all docs, schemas and complete example files; path reads one file with character pagination. No app source checkout is required.

name: webview_extension_list
description: List installed extensions, enabled/loaded state, tool counts, scoped MCP URLs, draft projects and host errors. refresh=true also reconciles disk and live workers.

name: webview_extension_create
description: Create a new draft in ~/extension-projects/<project_id>/src from the complete hello-mcp template. Does not overwrite an existing draft or install/execute its code. Read docs then edit with write_files. Add skills (skills/<name>.md guides for how to use the tools) to the same draft; see skills.md.

name: webview_extension_read_file
description: Read a UTF-8 draft file by relative path; omit path to list all draft files. Character offsets paginate content. Files are confined to this draft.

name: webview_extension_write_files
description: Create or replace UTF-8 files in an existing draft src directory. Up to 100 relative paths per call; nested directories are created. Does not change an installed worker until install/update succeeds. Skills go in skills/<name>.md, with optional detail files in skills/<name>/.

name: webview_extension_package
description: Validate draft package structure and create dist/<project_id>.zip. Includes every dependency inside src; rejects symlinks, escaping paths and package size limits. Does not execute JS or prove website behavior.

name: webview_extension_install
description: Install or update live from a draft project_id (automatically packages it) OR a local zip_path, exactly one. Set extension_id to update an installed extension while preserving its ID, folder, enabled state and storage; broken worker loads roll back. New installs are enabled.

name: webview_extension_set_enabled
description: Enable or disable one installed extension immediately, without restarting the app. Disabling releases automation input and stops the worker; already-submitted website actions cannot be undone.

name: webview_extension_reload
description: Reload an installed enabled worker after editing its installed files. Disabled extensions remain disabled. For draft edits use install with extension_id to update first. Active in-memory jobs/session state are lost.

name: webview_extension_rename
description: Rename the actual installed folder while preserving the stable extension ID, MCP URL and persistent storage.

name: webview_extension_test
description: Discover an enabled extension’s registered tools. Optionally supply tool_name and arguments to actually call one tool and return its MCP result. Calls may have real effects: use a dry_run argument only when the tested tool implements it. No tool is invoked by default.

name: webview_extension_logs
description: Read recent worker console/error logs, including failed worker starts. Logs are retained in host memory across reloads. Limit 1–200; omit extension_id to see all recent worker logs.
